title: DeepSDF shared decoder with structured Mirror geometry codes
hypothesis: For translated, rotated and scaled instances of a common canonical signed-distance field, five structured Mirror geometry coordinates produce lower few-shot reconstruction error and interpolation error per actual payload byte than five unconstrained DeepSDF latent coordinates in a jointly trained shared decoder.
physical_object: One shared neural decoder. Mirror/native-affine methods use a 2→64→64→1 decoder pretrained on the canonical circle; DeepSDF uses a 7→64→64→1 decoder trained jointly across instances. Decoder weights and all per-instance codes are charged.
mirror_coordinate: Per-instance m=(tx,ty,log_rx,log_ry,theta); transform query coordinates into a canonical frame, run shared decoder, and rescale the signed distance.
logical_multiplicity: A continuum of translated/rotated/scaled 2D implicit shape fields from one canonical decoder.
controls: DeepSDF auto-decoder: unconstrained five-dimensional per-instance latent code concatenated to query coordinates
native affine coordinate warp using the exact same five geometric parameters and decoder (algebraic equivalence audit; no Mirror-specific claim)
independent analytic ellipse SDF as task oracle/upper quality reference

task.domain: 2D signed-distance fields of ellipses, with approximate radial SDF d=min(rx,ry)*(sqrt((xlocal/rx)^2+(ylocal/ry)^2)-1).
task.interpolation: Interpolate pairs of heldout per-instance codes 50/50 and compare predicted field to the field generated by the midpoint of their geometric parameters.

development.selection_metric: held-out query NRMSE, 50/50 code-interpolation NRMSE, and actual serialized decoder-plus-code payload bytes.

storage.format: deterministic compressed NPZ with FP16 decoder weights, every per-shape code, and metadata
paid_objects: all per-instance Mirror or DeepSDF codes

compute.include: canonical decoder training, joint DeepSDF training, per-shape support-code adaptation, and query inference separately.
compute.active_compute_proxy: Analytical per-query scalar-op proxy includes all MLP linear layers plus code/warp work: Mirror/native affine 8626, DeepSDF 9216, analytic oracle 25. Report measured CPU throughput separately.

success_gate: On both development seeds, Mirror held-out query NRMSE <=0.03, is at least 2x lower than DeepSDF, payload <=0.80x DeepSDF, interpolation NRMSE <=0.05, and native-affine equivalence NRMSE <=1e-6. Passing only qualifies for fresh confirmation. The analytic oracle must reproduce targets within numerical precision.
failure_gate: FAIL if both decoders are learnable and Mirror misses any quality/bytes/interpolation gate; explicitly report no Mirror-specific advantage if native affine equivalence is exact.
boundaries: Synthetic geometric-field mechanism screen only; no 3D shape benchmark or natural-task claim.
DeepSDF adaptation uses only declared support points; query sets are disjoint.
Native affine coordinate warp is an intentionally strong simpler control expected to be functionally equivalent.
Fresh remains sealed unless the frozen development gate passes.
